# Eat Real Food NYC — extended agent index
# https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com/llms-full.txt
# Companion to https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com/llms.txt
# Last updated: 2026-11-20

This file lists the public, indexable documents. It does not list individual
restaurant URLs. Those live in the sitemap, which also carries each URL's
lastmod:

https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com/sitemap.xml

## Do not request

robots.txt disallows /search, /near-me, /compare, /saved, and /api/.
Those paths are user interface or private endpoints. Neighbourhood and dietary
hubs are the public way to enumerate restaurants.

## Newsletter

https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com/newsletter
https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com/newsletter/issues

An issue URL is /newsletter/issues/YYYY-MM-DD for a Thursday on or before
today. The sitemap includes that URL when the issue is one of the last 12
Thursday issues and the week has at least 3 published Grade A listings.
Other issue URLs stay reachable and are omitted from the sitemap. The email
edition started in November 2026.

## NYC Restaurant Compliance Weekly

https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com/data

For vendors. $79/month or $790/year.

## Catering

https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com/catering
https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com/catering/holiday-party-catering-nyc

The holiday page is for office holiday catering and Thanksgiving week
requests. It lists published Grade A restaurants for group orders. The
directory does not record a catering menu. The request form is free for
the person sending it.

## Restaurant listings

Every published restaurant is a page at:

https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com/restaurants/{slug}

Unpublished slugs return 404 and are omitted from the sitemap.
Diet-and-borough pages use:

https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com/nyc/{borough}/{diet-tag}-restaurants

Neighbourhood hubs use:

https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com/nyc/{borough}/{neighborhood}/healthy-restaurants

Both are included in the sitemap when they have enough published listings.
